components.name: Clipboard Button
components.description: Illustration of the native copy-list button; the native action copies filtered TSV records, but this snippet does not access the clipboard.

components.name: Search and Filter
components.description: Native ID/name search and seven record filters. The snippet illustrates wrapping controls, not working task filtering.
components.css: .ds-searchbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 7px; padding: 9px 10px; background: rgb(15% 15% 16% / .98); font: inherit; } .ds-search, .ds-filter { font: inherit; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(22% 22% 24%); border: 0; border-radius: 2px; padding: 3px 6px; } .ds-search { flex: 1 1 12em; min-width: 0; } .ds-filter { flex: 0 1 9em; max-width: 100%; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); } .ds-search:hover, .ds-filter:hover { background: rgb(29% 29% 31%); } .ds-search:focus-visible, .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(64% 76% 90%); background: rgb(30% 34% 39%); } .ds-filter:active { background: rgb(30% 34% 39%); }

components.name: Workspace Tabs
components.description: Five native tabs with a blue selected fill and overline. Graphics is optional, so the runtime may show four. This illustration fixes the first tab as selected; it does not implement navigation.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 7px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(29% 29% 31%); background: rgb(12% 12% 13% / .96); font: inherit; } .ds-tab { font: inherit; white-space: nowrap; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(15% 15% 16% / .98); border: 0; border-top: 1px solid transparent; padding: 3px 6px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected=true] { background: rgb(24% 30% 38%); border-top-color: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgb(30% 34% 39%); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(64% 76% 90%); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-tab:active { background: rgb(30% 34% 39%); }

components.name: GM Allowlist Tables
components.description: Three dense two-column native command tables separate diagnosis from approved state operations. Every action maps to a compiled allowlist entry; destructive kill is a red direct action with its current-room scope stated beside it.

components.css: .ds-gm { padding: 9px 10px; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(12% 12% 13% / .96); font: inherit; } .ds-gm-note { margin: 0 0 9px; color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); } .ds-gm-warning { margin: 0 0 5px; color: rgb(87% 75% 53%); } .ds-gm h3 { margin: 12px 0 4px; font: inherit; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); } .ds-gm-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px, 210px) 1fr; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(29% 29% 31%); } .ds-gm-row button { align-self: start; font: inherit; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(24% 24% 26%); border: 0; border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px 7px; } .ds-gm-row button:hover { background: rgb(32% 34% 38%); } .ds-gm-row button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(64% 76% 90%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-gm-row button:active { background: rgb(30% 38% 47%); } .ds-gm-row button.is-danger { background: rgb(36% 14% 14%); } .ds-gm-row button.is-danger:hover { background: rgb(48% 18% 18%); } .ds-gm-row small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); }

components.name: Selected Task Tile
components.description: Illustrative record, not captured task data: ID and completion percentage on the top row, then name and status/source. Native selection uses ID plus origin and opens local inspection only.
components.css: .ds-tile-surface { background: rgb(15% 15% 16% / .98); padding: 9px 10px; font: inherit; } .ds-tile { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 60px; height: calc(3em + 24px); padding: 10px; border: 0; text-align: left; font: inherit; line-height: 1em; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: transparent; } .ds-tile::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid rgb(30% 30% 32%); border-radius: 4px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-tile[aria-pressed=true] { background: rgb(24% 30% 38%); } .ds-tile[aria-pressed=true]::after { border-color: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-tile:hover { background: rgb(29% 32% 37%); } .ds-tile:active { background: rgb(30% 38% 47%); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(64% 76% 90%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile-idrow { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; height: 1em; } .ds-tile-id { color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); } .ds-tile-pct { color: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-tile-name, .ds-tile-meta { display: block; margin-top: 3px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-tile-meta { color: rgb(64% 76% 90%); }

components.name: Task Progress Ring
components.description: Illustrates the native 72px HUD ring; the inspector uses the same visual grammar at 88px. The completed arc is soft blue, milestone points are capped at 12, the first incomplete point is amber, and unknown progress renders --.
components.html:
43%
已完成 3 / 7 个配置节点后续 3 个节点
components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(12% 12% 13% / .96); font: inherit; } .ds-ring { position: relative; flex: 0 0 72px; width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(from -90deg, rgb(64% 76% 90%) 0 43%, rgb(29% 29% 31%) 43% 100%); } .ds-ring::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(12% 12% 13%); } .ds-ring-label { position: absolute; z-index: 2; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-point { position: absolute; z-index: 3; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin: -3.5px; border: 1px solid rgb(15% 15% 16%); border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-point-1 { left: 50%; top: 0; } .ds-point-2 { right: 3px; top: 26%; } .ds-point-3 { right: 3px; bottom: 26%; background: rgb(87% 75% 53%); } .ds-point-4 { left: 50%; bottom: 0; background: rgb(38% 39% 41%); } .ds-progress-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-progress-copy strong { font-weight: 400; } .ds-progress-copy span { color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); }

components.name: Task Chip Queue
components.description: A compact non-interactive HUD queue. Each chip combines the bracketed ID and task name in one tinted block; chips wrap to at most two rows and overflow into a +N chip. Tasks changed in the last 12 seconds move first and use semantic color; the current task follows in cyan, then active, traced, and unchanged tasks.
components.html: [100101] 示例任务[100204] 当前任务[100306] 失败任务[100408] 普通任务+6
components.css: .ds-activity { padding: 9px 10px; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(12% 12% 13% / .96); font: inherit; } .ds-activity-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 6px; max-height: calc(2 * (1em + 7px) + 4px); overflow: hidden; } .ds-chip { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3.5px 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(30% 30% 32%); border-radius: 4px; color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip.is-change { color: rgb(87% 75% 53%); border-color: currentColor; background: rgb(87% 75% 53% / .16); } .ds-chip.is-current { color: rgb(64% 76% 90%); border-color: currentColor; background: rgb(64% 76% 90% / .16); } .ds-chip.is-error { color: rgb(95% 62% 60%); border-color: currentColor; background: rgb(95% 62% 60% / .16); } .ds-activity-more { color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); }

components.name: HUD Display Settings
components.description: Native visibility checkbox and 25-100% background-opacity slider, initially 78%. Browser controls illustrate appearance only; they do not persist preferences or change the game.

components.css: .ds-settings { font: inherit; color: rgb(94% 94% 95%); background: rgb(12% 12% 13% / .96); border-radius: 3px; padding: 9px 10px; } .ds-visible { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; } .ds-check { accent-color: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-opacity-label { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-opacity { appearance: none; width: min(260px, 55%); height: 1em; background: rgb(22% 22% 24%); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-opacity:hover { background: rgb(29% 29% 31%); } .ds-opacity:active { background: rgb(30% 34% 39%); } .ds-opacity::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 10px; height: 1em; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(72% 73% 75%); } .ds-opacity:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-opacity::-moz-range-thumb { width: 10px; height: 1em; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(72% 73% 75%); } .ds-opacity:active::-moz-range-thumb { background: rgb(64% 76% 90%); } .ds-opacity:focus-visible, .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgb(64% 76% 90%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check:hover { outline: 1px solid rgb(72% 73% 75%); } .ds-setting-note { margin: 4px 0 0; color: rgb(72% 73% 75%); }

narrative.overview: A plain Windows/ReShade ImGui tool for identifying held tasks by id, name, and completion percentage. Neutral gray surfaces, readable text, restrained blue selection, and native controls replace the explicitly rejected cyberpunk / industrial identity.
keyCharacteristics: All held records are browsable, including hidden tasks and subtasks.
Search, filters, local selection, and clipboard actions support inspection.
Fixed task, location/scene, and explicitly approved GM actions are available without arbitrary command input.
A native Windows GUI installs, verifies, and configures the QA package while preserving the CLI automation entry.
A compact non-interactive HUD exposes current progress and recent task changes during gameplay.
In QA-only installs, Home opens a dedicated task workspace without ReShade's general-purpose tabs.

rules.name: State Is Text
rules.body: Pair state colors with explicit labels; id and name identify a record, while color only reinforces its state.

dos: Do keep id, name, and completion visible as the task identity.
Do preserve all-held-record browsing and distinguish client/server identity.
Do use native controls and font-relative responsive layout.
Do label retained data and provide actionable recovery guidance.
Do keep recent task changes visible without requiring the interactive workspace.
donts: Don't restore neon, cyberpunk titles, decorative gutters, or dashboard chrome.
Don't mutate quests, in-game tracking, or graphics configuration through inspection controls.
Don't treat HTML illustrations as native screenshots or runtime verification.
Don't fabricate a percentage when the task-line root cannot be resolved.
